jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Platform builds the machine learning systems that help businesses discover and use the Stripe products that meet their needs. Our recommendations reach users across the Dashboard, email, onboarding, documentation, and AI agent interfaces. We combine an understanding of each business with models that decide which recommendation is useful, when to show it, and how to learn from the outcome.

Our work spans recommendation and ranking models, contextual bandits, agent-based recommendations, and the data and evaluation systems behind them. We build shared capabilities that product, marketing, and sales teams can use across Stripe. Success means helping businesses take useful actions and adopt products that help them grow, while keeping recommendations relevant and avoiding unnecessary messages.

What you’ll do

You will build and operate production ML systems that improve how Stripe recommends products, content, and next steps to businesses. You will own work from problem definition and feature development through training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Working with data scientists, engineers, and product partners, you will turn model improvements into measurable user and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Design, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain models for recommendation, ranking, and personalized action selection across Growth Platform surfaces.
Improve contextual bandit and policy-learning approaches, including exploration, reward design, and how recommendations adapt to user context and feedback.
Build agent-based recommendation capabilities that use business context to identify relevant products and integration options, with evaluations that test recommendation quality and usefulness.
Develop reliable data and feature pipelines for training and inference. Improve data freshness, feature quality, and consistency between training and production.
Build reusable tooling for model evaluation, retraining, and safe rollout so the team can test and ship improvements faster.
Own the quality and operation of the team's ML components: write tested production code, monitor models and pipelines, investigate failures, and improve reliability, latency, and cost.
Design and analyze online experiments with data science partners. Connect offline evaluation to product adoption and incremental impact, with guardrails for dismissals, unsubscribes, and user experience.
Partner with product engineering to integrate models into recommendation delivery systems, and with ML infrastructure teams to use and improve Stripe's shared training, feature, and serving capabilities.
Work with product, marketing, and sales partners to identify problems that shared ML capabilities can solve, and make practical choices about where modeling adds value.

Who you are

You are a machine learning engineer with a builder mindset. You care about the business problem, the quality of the model, and what happens after it ships. You can move between modeling and software engineering, make practical tradeoffs, and take ownership of an ambiguous problem through production and measurement.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, or applied data science, with hands-on experience building and shipping ML models in production.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
Practical experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or scikit-learn.
Experience building data or feature pipelines, proficiency in SQL, and familiarity with distributed data processing tools such as Spark or PySpark.
A strong understanding of statistics, model evaluation, and experimentation, including the ability to recognize data leakage and distinguish offline model improvements from business impact.
Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production ML systems, and evaluating tradeoffs among model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a technical approach and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, product, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, personalization, or marketplace and advertising optimization.
Experience with contextual bandits, policy learning, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation.
Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, including structured extraction, embeddings, or recommendations grounded in user and business context.
Experience building reusable ML capabilities used by multiple products or teams, including training automation, feature systems, or model monitoring.
Experience with product growth, lifecycle messaging, or systems that balance short-term engagement with longer-term user outcomes.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $270,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Hands-on experience in building API specs, APIs on gateway and testing them using tools to validate the functionality.

Knowledge of data formats such as JSON, XML, and CSV. 
Proficiency or familiarity with Python or Java 
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

new_jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - AI & Automation
new_jobs.description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

Technical expert who partners with business analysts and engineers in requirements gathering and reviews. Responsible for analyzing and translating business information and technical requirements into an architectural blueprint.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities

Defines, designs, and oversees the systems and applications architecture for both current and future business applications.
Evaluates new and emerging technologies and developmental methodologies to find faster, cost effective, and more reliable solutions for existing and proposed systems.
Partners with infrastructure, application, and quality teams to ensure that applications meet business requirements, are well documented, and have processes in place for ongoing support and maintenance.
Drives standard and efficient applications and infrastructure design by aligning the infrastructure roadmap with the application technology strategy, hardware vendor roadmaps, and service capabilities.
Assists in identification of emerging technologies that could have a positive impact on the organization; helps evaluate strategic fit.
Contributes to technology strategy through consulting support: driving requirements gathering, collection of existing deployment plans, synthesis of business goals, and operating strategies.

Nature and Scope

Solutions require analysis and investigation.
Achieves planned results by decisions and actions based on professional methods, business principles, and practical experience.
Manages a group or team of professional individual contributors and/or indirectly supervises support staff.

Work Environment

Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Most of the time is spent sitting or standing in the same location and/or there may be a need to stoop regularly or move/lift light material or equipment (typically less than 8 pounds).
Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Education And Experience

Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally, 7+ years of experience in a related field. Advanced degree may offset less experience in some disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

We are seeking a hands-on architect who can personally design, prototype, and validate AI and automation solutions while establishing reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and engineering practices that enable enterprise-scale adoption. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation and has a proven track record of translating emerging technologies into practical business solutions.

AI, Databricks & Agent Architecture

Demonstrated experience designing and implementing AI solutions using Databricks, including AI/ML workloads, GenAI capabilities, Databricks Apps, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
Hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI-powered applications and intelligent agents leveraging enterprise data platforms and modern AI frameworks.
Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise data platforms, APIs, SaaS applications, and business systems.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot extensibility, Agent Builder, and agent-based architectures.
Experience designing and implementing solutions utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent orchestration patterns, and intelligent workflow automation.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, grounding techniques, memory patterns, and human-in-the-loop solution design.

Architecture, Design Patterns & Technical Leadership

Demonstrated ability to establish architecture standards, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and implementation frameworks that accelerate delivery and improve consistency across development teams.
Experience balancing innovation, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence when designing enterprise solutions.
Experience creating technical standards and architectural guidance for emerging technologies and AI-enabled solutions.
Proven ability to evaluate new technologies and determine practical enterprise adoption strategies.

Hands-On Engineering & Solution Delivery

Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying production AI, automation, and cloud-based solutions.
Hands-on experience building proof-of-concepts, prototypes, accelerators, and reference implementations that validate architectural approaches and emerging technologies.
Experience mentoring development teams and providing technical leadership throughout the full solution lifecycle, from concept through production deployment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities across AI, data, cloud, and automation platforms.

DevOps & Engineering Excellence

Experience implementing Azure DevOps best practices, including source control strategies, branching models, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and environment management practices.
Experience establishing software engineering standards and delivery practices that improve quality, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
Experience developing reusable frameworks, templates, and technical accelerators that increase developer productivity and solution consistency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a builder, designer, and innovator who is equally comfortable whiteboarding enterprise architecture, building working prototypes in Databricks, reviewing code, mentoring developers, and evaluating emerging technologies. They possess a strong engineering mindset, remain hands-on with technology, and have a passion for helping development teams deliver scalable, secure, and impactful AI and automation solutions.

If you’re looking to play a role in building America, consider one of our open opportunities. We can’t wait to meet you.

new_jobs.title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Discovery
new_jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

new_jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Predictive Planner, Systems Arch
new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Predictive Planning team (PrePlan) develops and deploys state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that predict the future state of the world and plan the Waymo Driver’s behavior. Our mission is to transform Waymo's unprecedented scale of driving data into robust, generalizable, and performant deep neural networks. These models enable the autonomous vehicle to navigate complex environments safely and efficiently.

The system architecture team handles the onboard contract of the model with the system, including kinematics, interfaces and representations. Our team’s mission is to work across the stack, building the best setup for the model to drive. We tackle this through projects in data, modeling, metrics, and the overall planner system.

In this role, you will report to a Technical Lead Manager.

You Will

Tackle challenging real-world problems with ML and engineering solutions.
Use state of the art techniques to design and build ML models, deploy them in the real world on production vehicles
Design and build the necessary architectures, algorithms, pipelines and evaluation systems on Google's extensive data infrastructure
Collaborate with researchers, product area owners and engineers to develop safe, smooth planning behavior for all road users & deliver product requirements.

You Have

Bachelors in Computer Science, ML, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on experience with modern deep learning libraries (eg: TensorFlow, JAX, Pytorch)
Proficient programming skills (eg: Python, C/C++)
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
4+ years of experience in Machine Learning modeling and/or Autonomous Vehicles systems

We Prefer

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field
Publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, IROS, CoRL, ACL, or EMNLP
Prior software development or ML research industry experience (including internships)
General software engineering experience solving motion planning or related robotics problems
Experience applying or evaluating ML-based systems in production environments
Experience with performance optimization of deep models, including with respect to specific hardware architectures

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

$213,000—$263,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Senior Data & Applied Scientist - Ontologies & Semantics
new_jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.

Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Senior Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.

What You'll Build

The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible.

Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, various external providers (such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow), and MES/IoT systems into unified semantic layers.
Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production.
Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets.
Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality.
Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows.
Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement.
Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments.
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases.
Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding.
Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement.
Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in agile environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end. (SAP knowledge is a strong accelerator)
Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub.
Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL).
Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets.
Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures.
Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas.
Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks across complex application landscapes.

Where you belong

The Application AI team sits at the foundation layer - We build the LLM systems and intelligent infrastructure that run across SAP's global platforms, which means the work you do here doesn't just influence one product, it sets the direction for how AI operates at enterprise scale. A core part of that challenge is making AI genuinely understand the business not just process text, but reason over richly structured enterprise data through robust data ontologies and semantic knowledge frameworks that give models real context about how SAP's world is organized. This is a team that values engineers who think like owners: people who want to define the architecture, not just implement a spec. You'll work in an environment designed around trust and autonomy, where the expectation is that you move fast, make calls, and drive outcomes without layers of approval slowing you down.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior / Staff Full-Stack AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Suno's song creation agent takes a plain-language request, plans the steps, and calls our music models and audio tools to make the song. We're hiring Senior / Staff Full-Stack / AI Engineers to build the backend, data and evals behind it, working alongside ML engineers, PMs and the product teams who build on top of it. Most of the work is making a nondeterministic system behave, and proving that it does before anything ships. You'll join a small team and own your part of the agent, with a real say in how the rest of it is built.

Listen to the song we made about it:
https://suno.com/s/YIofhzxQWKjXfwPS

What You'll Do

Build and run the backend for an AI agent that plans multi-step requests and calls music models and audio tools.
Design the evals, datasets and release gates that decide whether a change to the agent ships, and make the call when the results are noisy.
Develop the data pipelines that feed the agent and its evals, working alongside ML engineers.
Create internal tools for running and reviewing evals.
Share on-call and launch support for a high-traffic production system, and help the team ramp new engineers as it grows.
Help make creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by shipping the features people use to turn an idea into music.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

4–6 years building and scaling general backend systems in production, in any language: services at scale, observability and on-call ownership.
Experience shipping and operating an LLM-powered agent or feature in production, for external or internal users, with multi-step tool calling.
Experience building evals for nondeterministic systems, such as regression sets, graders or LLM judges, and using the results to decide what ships.
Comfort on a small team that runs production: handling ambiguity, unblocking yourself, and working with ML engineers, PMs and partner teams.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with Python backends.
Experience building internal tools or dashboards, in TypeScript and React, for reviewing model output.
Experience with audio, music or other media generation systems.
Experience with LLM tracing and observability tools.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno SF office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

$228K- $363K

As a Staff Data Scientist at Walmart, you will leverage advanced analytical techniques and machine learning to transform complex data into actionable business insights. Our team develops foundational models tailored for Walmart’s e-commerce platform by leveraging large-scale user interactions to create detailed representations of users, products, and search queries. These models support scalable search, advertising, recommendation, and personalization solutions. Team members apply expertise in data science, machine learning, and software engineering to optimize model performance, training, and deployment. new_jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Platform
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Platform builds the machine learning systems that help businesses discover and use the Stripe products that meet their needs. Our recommendations reach users across the Dashboard, email, onboarding, documentation, and AI agent interfaces. We combine an understanding of each business with models that decide which recommendation is useful, when to show it, and how to learn from the outcome.

Our work spans recommendation and ranking models, contextual bandits, agent-based recommendations, and the data and evaluation systems behind them. We build shared capabilities that product, marketing, and sales teams can use across Stripe. Success means helping businesses take useful actions and adopt products that help them grow, while keeping recommendations relevant and avoiding unnecessary messages.

What you’ll do

You will build and operate production ML systems that improve how Stripe recommends products, content, and next steps to businesses. You will own work from problem definition and feature development through training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Working with data scientists, engineers, and product partners, you will turn model improvements into measurable user and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Design, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain models for recommendation, ranking, and personalized action selection across Growth Platform surfaces.
Improve contextual bandit and policy-learning approaches, including exploration, reward design, and how recommendations adapt to user context and feedback.
Build agent-based recommendation capabilities that use business context to identify relevant products and integration options, with evaluations that test recommendation quality and usefulness.
Develop reliable data and feature pipelines for training and inference. Improve data freshness, feature quality, and consistency between training and production.
Build reusable tooling for model evaluation, retraining, and safe rollout so the team can test and ship improvements faster.
Own the quality and operation of the team's ML components: write tested production code, monitor models and pipelines, investigate failures, and improve reliability, latency, and cost.
Design and analyze online experiments with data science partners. Connect offline evaluation to product adoption and incremental impact, with guardrails for dismissals, unsubscribes, and user experience.
Partner with product engineering to integrate models into recommendation delivery systems, and with ML infrastructure teams to use and improve Stripe's shared training, feature, and serving capabilities.
Work with product, marketing, and sales partners to identify problems that shared ML capabilities can solve, and make practical choices about where modeling adds value.

Who you are

You are a machine learning engineer with a builder mindset. You care about the business problem, the quality of the model, and what happens after it ships. You can move between modeling and software engineering, make practical tradeoffs, and take ownership of an ambiguous problem through production and measurement.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, or applied data science, with hands-on experience building and shipping ML models in production.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
Practical experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or scikit-learn.
Experience building data or feature pipelines, proficiency in SQL, and familiarity with distributed data processing tools such as Spark or PySpark.
A strong understanding of statistics, model evaluation, and experimentation, including the ability to recognize data leakage and distinguish offline model improvements from business impact.
Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production ML systems, and evaluating tradeoffs among model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a technical approach and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, product, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, personalization, or marketplace and advertising optimization.
Experience with contextual bandits, policy learning, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation.
Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, including structured extraction, embeddings, or recommendations grounded in user and business context.
Experience building reusable ML capabilities used by multiple products or teams, including training automation, feature systems, or model monitoring.
Experience with product growth, lifecycle messaging, or systems that balance short-term engagement with longer-term user outcomes.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $270,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.  

The  Data Scientist, Full Stack
supports the modernization of IREN’s global Supply Chain systems and tools portfolio. Reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering, this individual-contributor role builds and operates the pipelines, data models, and dashboards that underpin the teams analytics, and contributes to the data architecture, tooling standards, and ways of working as they are established. The work spans GPU and compute hardware, networking, power and electrical equipment, construction materials and services – categories with long lead times, constrained supply and high capital intensity, where data quality directly affects delivery dates and cost.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. 
Job requirements

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in data engineering or data science, with at least 1 year building pipelines and data models for supply chain, procurement, operations or finance data.
Strong data-driven storytelling skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to technical and business audiences.
Working understanding of supply chain processes and stakeholder interactions, and experience working with ERP/MRP, CLM, PLM, QMS tools.
Strong SQL and Python; familiarity with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift) and an orchestration tool (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar).
Exposure to AI-native analytics tools and workflows.
Experience working with data from ERP and procurement systems (for example SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics, Coupa or Ariba) via APIs, extracts or CDC.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling, master-data concepts and data-quality practices.
Software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD basics.
Preferred: experience in data center, AI infrastructure, energy, construction or other capital-project-heavy industries with long-lead equipment (GPUs, networking, transformers, switchgear, generators).
Strong hands-on problem solving, data analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to operate autonomously across analytics, engineering, and supply chain teams.

Other important requirements
Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing, may be required according to company policies.
Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
This role requires willingness to travel domestically and internationally to supplier and vendor sites, data centers, implementation partner locations, and industry events.
IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

Job Responsibilities

Data pipelines and integration
Design, build and maintain reliable ELT/ETL pipelines from supply chain source systems (ERP, procurement/P2P, inventory and warehouse, project controls, logistics and supplier portals) into the analytics platform.
Integrate external data such as supplier catalogs, lead-time and market-price feeds, freight and customs data, and OEM shipment notifications.
Operate and improve pipeline orchestration, scheduling, monitoring and alerting so data lands on time and failures are caught before users see them.

Data modeling and standards
Build and document the supply chain data model: supplier, material/part, purchase order, contract, receipt, inventory, shipment and project/site dimensions and facts.
Help define conformed dimensions and master-data rules (supplier hierarchy, category taxonomy, site and project codes) under the guidance of the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering and master-data owners.
Follow and help refine the team’s engineering standards: version control, code review, testing, environments and deployment.

Data quality and governance
Implement automated data-quality checks (completeness, freshness, reconciliation to source) and publish data-quality metrics.
Maintain data lineage, definitions and a catalog so analysts and business users can trust and find the data.
Implement the defined security model and privacy safeguards, address data quality issues, and contribute to governance processes within allocated areas of ownership.

Analytics enablement
Partner with analysts to deliver the datasets behind spend cubes, supplier scorecards, lead-time and on-time-delivery tracking, inventory health and transformation KPIs.
Design, build, and launch dashboards and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different domains.
Contribute to the data foundations for forecasting and planning use cases (demand and lead-time forecasting, should-cost, supplier risk) and support analytics and data science teammates in productionizing models.
Support system-selection and implementation work (procurement, planning and supplier-management tools) by defining data requirements and integration patterns.

Job Benefits

The IREN Package  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.

new_jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/29/2026

This is a Hybrid role based out of Cisco's San Jose office.

MEET THE TEAM

Cisco’s AI Defense team is a fast-growing, elite engineering group dedicated to securing the next generation of enterprise AI platforms, autonomous agents, and foundation models. We build the mission-critical security control and data planes that safeguard Cisco’s AI-native portfolio—including Cloud Control, AI Canvas, and AI Studio—against prompt injection, agent misuse, and data exfiltration. Our team brings together world-class distributed systems engineers, security researchers, and AI practitioners in an agile, high-velocity, and collaborative environment. This is a rare opportunity to define the industry standard for AI security at Cisco’s global enterprise scale.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Principal Software Engineer for AI Defense, you will serve as the chief technical authority driving the end-to-end security architecture for Cisco's enterprise AI ecosystems. You will architect high-throughput control and data planes that safeguard foundation models, multi-agent frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution from emerging cyber threats. In this role, you will balance strategic cross-organizational influence with hands-on systems development, translating complex AI safety research into production-hardened software. Success in this position means establishing resilient, zero-trust security boundaries that empower global enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents with absolute confidence. You will lead by example—mentoring senior engineers, shaping engineering standards, and defining the future of AI defense at Cisco scale.

Architect enterprise AI defense platforms by owning the technical vision and system design for AI Defense control planes, data planes, policy engines, and real-time posture assessment services to safeguard enterprise AI workflows against adversarial attacks.
Write and deploy high throughput microservices and APIs in Go and Python to process high-volume telemetry streams under strict latency and reliability SLAs.
Harden agentic AI and model security through design runtime guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) policy enforcement, and automated remediation engines to neutralize prompt injection, model jailbreaks, and tool-abuse risks.
Drive cross-organizational technical strategy by partnering with Product Management, Security Research, and platform engineering teams across Cisco to establish zero-trust architectures and convert complex customer security requirements into production-ready software.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science and 15+ years of relevant software engineering experience, Master’s degree and 12+ years, or Ph.D. and 8+ years building enterprise-scale distributed systems.
8+ years of hands-on software development experience utilizing Go, Python, or Java to build production microservices, SDKs, and REST/gRPC APIs.
Experience architecting and operating multi-tenant cloud-native infrastructure on AWS or GCP, including container orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) and event-driven data streaming (Kafka/MSK).
5+ years of core engineering experience in cybersecurity domains (e.g., cloud security posture management, identity/access governance, RBAC/ABAC, threat modeling, or security analytics).
Experience building, debugging, or securing LLM applications, agentic frameworks, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures in production.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in AI safety engineering, including prompt-injection defenses, graph-based security models, runtime model observability, and policy-as-code frameworks.
Experience leading greenfield 0-to-1 platform initiatives and executing zero-downtime migrations for high-throughput enterprise SaaS.
Experience implementing zero-trust network boundaries, secrets management, service meshes (Envoy/Istio), and automated CI/CD DevSecOps pipelines.
Technical mentorship and cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to build consensus across research, engineering, and executive stakeholders.
Active contributor to open-source security tools, agent-to-agent communication protocols, or industry AI safety standards.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Driver Refinement and Validation’s (DRV) mission is to build upon the high-quality ML Driver developed by Driver Intelligence, refining its performance to improve autonomous driving in specific, complex real-world contexts and problem areas (e.g., Ride-Hailing contexts). It aims to ensure that the Waymo Driver always computes safe, compliant, comfortable, and useful plans. As an Engineer in DRV, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge machine learning and real-world vehicle performance, engineering the validation and onboard systems that ensure the autonomous vehicle reliably executes intelligent and predictable maneuvers.

You Will

Develop next-generation, ML-powered systems that enhance the capabilities of the ML driver and accelerate the rapid scaling of Waymo’s business
Fine-tune, adapt, and benchmark state-of-the-art generative models to improve autonomous vehicle perception, motion prediction, and trajectory planning
Write high-quality, scalable, and thoroughly tested code to bring cutting-edge ML into production
Partner with world-class engineers and product managers to deliver safe and smooth autonomous vehicle behaviors

You Have

MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of industry experience deploying, evaluating, and maintaining ML-based systems in real-world, production environments
Proficient programming skills in Python and/or C++, coupled with strong analytical and debugging abilities
Expertise with modern deep learning frameworks, such as JAX or PyTorch

We Prefer

Experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, and ML systems
Domain expertise in solving prediction, behaviors, motion planning, or related robotics problems
ML post-training experience
Prior industry experience (e.g. internships) in applied ML or software development
Publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL, ACL, or EMNLP)

new_jobs.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Within HPE’s Office of the CTO and HPE Labs, the AI Enablement team builds on HPE’s established AI research, engineering, and market expertise to accelerate the transition of innovation into production by turning promising ideas into dependable, governed, reusable capabilities that HPE’s business units and customers can adopt and build on.

We sit at the seam between invention and impact. We don’t just prototype; we make AI real, repeatable, and trusted at enterprise scale. The team combines HPE’s deep technical expertise with a collaborative, high-standards, and intellectually honest culture focused on solving hard problems. If you want to shape how a world-class technology company operationalizes AI, this is the team.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a technical lead for the AI Enablement team. As a tech lead, you’ll independently drive high-impact “lighthouse” AI use cases from concept through production: owning the technical direction, partnering across functions and business units to deliver value, and establishing scalable architectures, patterns, and standards that make each subsequent use case faster and more effective.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone who's technically excellent and genuinely good with people: equally comfortable in an architecture deep-dive, a stakeholder negotiation, and a mentoring conversation. You'll have unusual scope to shape both the work and the team from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Lead lighthouse use cases end-to-end. Independently own selected high-impact AI use cases from problem framing and solution design through production deployment and the transition to operational ownership, bringing LLM, agentic, and applied AI approaches to bear where they fit.
Build for production and measurable impact. Design the architecture of AI systems for scalability, performance, reliability, security, and supportability. Establish evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, documentation, and performance metrics that enable trusted adoption in real workflows, and continuously improve the systems based on operational feedback.
Create reusable patterns. Turn each delivery into reference architectures, tooling, and repeatable patterns that lower the cost of the next use case, so the team scales through leverage, not headcount.
Partner across the organization. Work closely with stakeholders across business units, product, engineering, data, security, and HPE Labs to translate customer requirements, business needs, and industry trends into AI products, solutions, and systems improvements. Provide technical guidance, communicate tradeoffs and impact to technical and executive stakeholders, secure sponsorship and operational ownership, and drive adoption through credibility and influence.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship. Serve as a recognized technical authority for significant AI initiatives, guide architecture and design reviews across projects, promote consistency and engineering best practices, and coach less-experienced engineers through code review, design review, pairing, and example. Contribute to knowledge sharing across the organization and help cultivate a collaborative, high-standards team culture.
Help shape how we work. Contribute to the team's intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery practices as we build them, bringing judgment about what's worth doing and how to do it well.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience & technical skills:

Typically, 10+ years of relevant experience in applied AI/ML engineering, or software engineering, including hands-on delivery of AI/ML systems into production.
Demonstrated ability to take an AI/ML solution from concept to production independently, not just modeling, but the full lifecycle: data pipelines, deployment, evaluation, and operationalization.
Demonstrated experience shipping an LLM or agentic system that real users depend on, with ownership of its evaluation, reliability, and operation after launch.
Experience building and scaling enterprise agentic AI solutions across complex, production-grade environments.
Strong, current depth across AI and machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, natural language processing, large language models, generative AI, agentic systems, and statistical modeling, with practical experience in LLMOps or MLOps, evaluation, and production model lifecycle management.
Solid systems and software engineering fundamentals; comfort with cloud-native and/or hybrid deployment environments.
Working knowledge of responsible-AI and governance practices: evaluation, guardrails, security-by-design, data privacy, and how to build them in rather than bolt them on.
Bachelor's or master’s in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Leadership & Collaboration

Proven ability to lead technical work and influence across teams without formal authority: earning adoption by being useful and credible, not by mandate.
Combines strong technical depth with a clear strategic vision, helping shape scalable designs, reusable patterns, and best practices.
Excellent stakeholder and communication skills: able to translate technical tradeoffs into business terms, align diverse groups, and build trust across functions and business units.
A track record of mentoring and developing less-experienced engineers; genuine interest in growing others.
Strong judgment and problem-solving: knowing which problems matter, when something is production-ready, and when to escalate or ask.

Who Thrives Here

Success in this role depends as much on how you work as on what you know. The people who thrive here and strengthen the culture we value tend to be:

Builders and finishers: energized by shipping real, dependable things, not just prototypes; they care about the unglamorous 80% (integration, evaluation, support) that makes AI work.
Intellectually honest: comfortable saying "I don't know," naming risks early, giving and receiving direct feedback, and challenging ideas respectfully. We're building a culture of psychological safety and high standards, and that starts with candor.
Collaborative by instinct: they bring people together across boundaries, assume good intent, and would rather make the whole team succeed than be the smartest person in the room.
Curious and humble: eager to learn, including from the researchers whose work they help transition and from the business partners whose problems they solve.
Growth-minded and generous: they treat setbacks as learning, lift the people around them, and want to help shape a team that's both excellent and a good place to work.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

We are hiring Sr ML Engineers across two teams.

Admin Central is building the future of how administrators work across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. Within Admin Central, Workday implementations move from being driven by human effort to being powered by intelligence designed into the platform.

The Business Process Optimize (BPO) team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, new agentic functionality, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us!

About The Role

Key Responsibilities

ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines: Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage.
Low-Latency Inference & Scaling: Optimize real-time model inference and scoring microservices to ensure sub-second response times across high-concurrency multi-tenant environments.
LLM & Agentic Observability: Integrate telemetry and tracing (OpenTelemetry, LangChain, LangSmith) into ML pipelines to track model performance, prompt/response drift, and execution efficiency.
Data & Feature Store Architecture: Collaborate with core backend engineers to leverage big data platforms (ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Spark) for high-dimensional feature retrieval and analytics.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineering, SRE, and Legal/Compliance to translate complex business and governance requirements into scalable ML solutions.

About You

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience in machine learning development, researching, developing, and implementing advanced machine learning models and techniques, with at least 4+ years focused explicitly on building, deploying, and operating production Machine Learning systems at scale.
5+ years of experience and proficiency in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and GenAI/LLM orchestration, utilizing frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside proficiency in Java, Go, Scala, or C++ for high-performance backend systems.

Other Qualifications

Data Processing & Pipelines: Strong ability in distributed processing (Spark, Flink, Kafka) and high-throughput columnar/vector storage (ClickHouse, Pinecone, Milvus) to design robust ML data pipelines.
AI/ML Expertise: Solid knowledge of RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, intent classification, and recommendation engines—applying ML algorithms and Model-Based Design (including MCP tooling and structured agentic execution paths) to multi-agent orchestration, contextual reasoning, and workflow optimization.
Data Analysis & Feature Engineering: Experience leading EDA on multi-tenant execution logs to validate prompt/response accuracy and optimize tool usage, paired with strong feature engineering skills for vector embeddings, feature stores, and multi-tenant data isolation.
Model Lifecycle: Experience leading model building (foundation model adaptation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, low-latency inference) and deep understanding of the model development lifecycle, including MLOps platforms (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, SageMaker) for monitoring, latency tracking, and retraining at scale.
Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangSmith, DSPy), with experience deploying scalable ML systems in cloud-native production using Docker, Kubernetes, gRPC/REST APIs, and CI/CD under strict high-availability (99.9% uptime) and low-latency SLAs.
Team Collaboration: Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions.
Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering; Master's or PhD strongly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Ops
new_jobs.description:
About Vinci

Every physical thing you touch exists because somebody successfully navigated the laws of physics: the chips in your phone, the vehicles on the road, the data centers powering AI. Physics determines what can be built, how well it performs, and where it breaks. Yet the tools engineers use to understand physical behavior are too slow and too specialized to use continuously while designing, so critical decisions get made with only a partial view of how a system will behave.

Our mission is to make physical reasoning as accessible to engineers as language became through modern AI. This is not an attempt to build slightly better engineering software. It is an attempt to change how physical products are designed. Our technology is used today by many of the world's most advanced semiconductor and electronics organizations, including nearly half of the twenty largest companies in the industry. We are backed by Khosla Ventures and Eclipse Ventures.

The role

Our foundation model learns physics from simulations, and we generate the simulation data ourselves. The simulations encapsulate real-world, validated physical results. Our aim is to create a data corpus covering multiple types of physics over an exhaustive set of physical objects.

Our data corpus is expanding. We currently operate on the petabyte scale, and our data volume is growing rapidly. We are hiring the engineer who makes that possible: the person who owns the pipeline from "here is a generation recipe" to "here is a versioned, validated dataset a training run can consume," and the ML lifecycle around it. Your job is to expand our job scheduling and execution platform to ensure that campaigns of millions of simulations, ML training runs, and future jobs are simple to run, fault-tolerant, and well-cataloged for traceability.

This is hands-on engineering in a production codebase. You will write, test and ship the code yourself.

What You'll Do

Scale the data generation pipeline by orders of magnitude. Our generation framework runs real simulations on 3D parts, and we are scaling from thousands of simulations to millions.
Own dataset lineage and reproducibility. Every completed simulation records how it was produced and the recipe how it can be augmented for future data generation jobs.
Build data quality into the pipeline. Acceptance criteria, bad-sample flagging, coverage and distribution checks against the target parameter space, and per-field statistics on every sample.
Run the job platform. Our GPU scheduler uses Temporal as a durable control plane and Ray as the execution plane, with priority, admission, cancellation and per-job isolated environments. You will extend it as generation, training and validation compete for the same fleet.
Close the loop between data and models. You will own training job launch (Ray Train, torchrun), checkpoint management and the model registry, and the path that puts a trained checkpoint back into the pipeline, for example as a warm start for the next generation campaign or as an inference pipeline in production.
Integrate with the infrastructure team. Our compute is managed by our infrastructure experts, and you will work closely with them to ensure compute and data resources will meet workload needs.
Make costs visible. Know what a sample costs to generate, store and serve, by physics type and by configuration. Find the stage that wastes GPU time, and make the case for which data is worth generating next.
Keep the codebase healthy as it grows. Write tests first, keep CI fast, write schema migrations that are safe on populated databases, and document what you build so the next engineer can operate it without you.

What We're Looking For

5+ years building production data or ML pipelines, including at least 2 years where you owned a pipeline that ran on GPUs at meaningful scale
Experience running large batch or simulation workloads: thousands of long-running jobs, partial failures, retries, preemption, and making sure work is neither lost nor duplicated
Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: clean abstractions, typed code, and a test suite you trust
Comfort with relationalrelationa and NoSQLl databases at scale: schema design, migrations on live data, bulk writes, and query performance once tables reach hundreds of millions of rows
Experience with workflow orchestration or distributed execution frameworks, such as Temporal, Ray, Airflow, Argo, Kubernetes Jobs or Slurm
Working knowledge of cloud object storage and of the file formats that feed training at high throughput
You measure your work by what it lets other people do: experiments run, data generated, failures caught early

Nice to have

PyTorch distributed training (DDP, FSDP, torchrun, Ray Train), checkpointing, and experiment tracking
MPI, CUDA or HIP, or experience operating numerical solvers in production
Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and private networking for multi-environment deployments
Scientific or simulation data: CFD, FEA, EDA, CAD, or other large numerical or geometric datasets
Designing parameter sampling or curriculum strategies for training-data coverage
Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability stacks

Is this you?

This role sits at the point where physics simulation turns into an AI model that understands physics. You do not need to be a physicist or a model researcher, but you should want to understand both well enough to build the system that connects them. If you have been the person who knew why last night's batch failed, what it cost, and how to make sure it does not happen again, this is likely a good fit.

We are a small team with a production codebase and a very large data target. Much of what an ML platform team would give you at a larger company does not exist here yet. Building it is the job.

Why Join Us

Real impact, now. Vinci is already deployed on production programs at leading semiconductor companies. The work you do this week shows up in real hardware, not a demo.
A hard, unsolved problem. Help change when and how physics enters hardware design, at the intersection of AI, first-principles physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.
Exceptional people. Work alongside world-class engineers and researchers, some of the best you’ll encounter at what they do.
Speed and ownership. We ship fast, decisions don’t wait for committees, and your input directly shapes the product and the company.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Great code assistants have to understand code the way an experienced engineer does, not as a wall of text but as a living structure of symbols, calls, types, and dependencies that span an entire repository. Most AI tools today flatten all of that into tokens and lose the structure that makes real software navigable. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to fix that, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist to build the intelligence layer that lets our AI development tools reason about code through its true structure. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.

You will design how we turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a single unified representation our models can reason over. This is a build-oriented research role where the questions are still open: how to fuse heterogeneous code signals, how to represent a whole repository so a model can find and use the right context, and how to ground an assistant's reasoning in the structure of real software rather than text alone. Your work will reach millions of developers, and you will own this direction end to end, from framing the approach to shipping it in a product engineers rely on every day.

Key job responsibilities

Design a unified representation of code that fuses static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context
Build the methods and models that consume that representation to power code navigation, retrieval, and reasoning at repository scale
Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale
Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)
Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems
